connector.name: ASMI - AI avatars for your site
connector.registryDescription: Design your site's AI avatar in the ASMI studio; your coding agent ships it into your repo.
connector.summary: Hosted at broen.tech over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace tech.broen, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: ASMI API key (auk_…) — create one in the ASMI studio's Deploy dialog at broen.tech/apps/asmi. Authorization: Bearer works too.
